steps.text: From the Edron depot, go down the drain in the south-west corner of the castle.
steps.source: From the Edron depot, go down the drain in the south-west corner of the castle (Mapper Coords 129.141, 124.84, 7).

steps.text: Follow the cave down and up until you come out in a grassy area.
steps.source: There is only one way to go, so follow this cave down and up until you emerge in a grassy area (Mapper Coords 129.105, 124.67, 7).

steps.text: Go down the hole of the troll cave to the north-west.
steps.source: Go to the Troll Cave to the north-west (Mapper Coords 129.93, 124.32, 7), and go down the hole.

steps.text: Up to 20 troll champions if no one has been down for a while. Low levels: go in slowly, there's a narrow passage where only one can attack you.
steps.source: Be prepared to face up to 20 Troll Champions if no one has been down there for a while. For low level players it's advised to move in slowly, there's a small passage where only one of the Troll Champions can attack you.

steps.text: Follow the path north and east, and go down the hole.
steps.source: Follow this path to the north and east, and go down the hole.

steps.text: Follow the path to the room in the north and go down the hole.
steps.source: Follow this path to the room to the north and go down the hole.

steps.text: Trolls, bears, troll champions and a frost troll down here.
steps.source: Here you will face a number of Trolls, Bears, Troll Champions, and a Frost Troll.
